title: Estágio no CCFLA/PUC-Rio
description:
O Climate Policy Initiative (CPI) é uma organização com experiência em análise de políticas públicas e finanças climáticas, que possui sete escritórios ao redor do mundo. Nosso trabalho apoia políticas climáticas, através de rigorosa análise e pesquisa baseada em evidência, parcerias estratégicas com membros do governo e da sociedade civil, por meio de uma abordagem construtiva e da colaboração direta com tomadores de decisão. No Brasil, o CPI é afiliado à Pontifícia Universidade Católica do Rio de Janeiro (PUC‑Rio) e atua no aprimoramento de políticas públicas e finanças sustentáveis a fim de promover a transição para uma economia de baixo carbono. Para mais informações sobre o Climate Policy Initiative no Brasil, acesse: climatepolicyinitiative.org/brazil.

Nos últimos cinco anos, a atuação do CPI no financiamento climático urbano por meio da Cities Climate Finance Leadership Alliance (CCFLA) cresceu significativamente. O CCFLA é a única coalizão multinível e multissetorial dedicada a reduzir o déficit de investimentos em projetos climáticos urbanos e infraestrutura subnacional em todo o mundo. O CCFLA foi lançado na Cúpula do Clima da ONU, em setembro de 2014, e renovado na Cúpula do Clima da ONU, em setembro de 2019, quando o CPI passou a sediar seu Secretariado.

Hoje, o CCFLA conta com mais de 80 membros comprometidos em mobilizar financiamento para a ação climática em nível urbano em escala até 2030. Seus membros representam algumas das maiores redes de cidades e governos subnacionais do mundo (C40, ICLEI, UCLG, GCOM, entre outras), importantes instituições financeiras públicas e privadas (Banco Mundial, EBRD, KfW, entre outras), além de governos e organizações internacionais e de pesquisa.

Como parte da Estratégia 2025–2030, foi criado um Hub Local no Brasil para fortalecer a colaboração entre atores, destravar o financiamento climático urbano e impulsionar investimentos em desenvolvimento urbano resiliente.

Sobre a Vaga

Estamos buscando um/a estagiário/a para assistir a equipe do CCLFA no Brasil.

O/a Aluno/a Desenvolverá As Seguintes Atividades

  • Auxiliar na coleta, organização e análise básica de dados sobre tendências de financiamento climático urbano;
  • Apoiar o engajamento com membros e parceiros da CCFLA, incluindo a preparação de reuniões e eventos, bem como atividades de acompanhamento;
  • Auxiliar em tarefas logísticas e de coordenação relacionadas às atividades e eventos do Hub Local;
  • Prestar apoio geral às atividades do programa junto à equipe do Secretariado da CCFLA;
  • Aprimorar seu conhecimento sobre a agenda climática no Brasil e no mundo;
  • Aprofundar seu conhecimento sobre as instituições envolvidas na política pública climática.

Requisitos

  • Ser estudante de graduação ou mestrado da PUC‑Rio nos cursos de Arquitetura e Urbanismo, Economia, Relações Internacionais, ou áreas correlatas;
  • Ter interesse pela agenda climática no Brasil;
  • Ter interesse em pesquisa e avaliação de políticas públicas;
  • Ter facilidade com escrita e síntese de informações, com capacidade de apoiar a redação e edição de relatórios, apresentações e outros materiais;
  • Ter alguma experiência em pesquisa quantitativa e qualitativa; conhecimentos básicos de análise de dados (como Excel ou ferramentas semelhantes) é desejável, mas não um requisito;
  • Apresentar domínio de português e inglês.

Regime de trabalho

Carga horária: 20h ou 30h semanais a depender da disponibilidade do estudante.

Trabalho realizado no modelo híbrido com flexibilidade de horário, alinhado consoante as aulas.

Local de trabalho presencial às terças e quintas: Centro de Pesquisas Matteo Ricci da PUC‑Rio, Estrada da Gávea, no 50, 3º/4º andar – Rio de Janeiro – RJ.

O contrato será de 6 meses, com possibilidade de renovação. O/a estagiário/a terá direito a 30 dias corridos de férias remuneradas, programados para o mês de janeiro.

Remuneração

Será Compatível Com o Grau De Formação e o Número De Horas. Para 30 Horas Semanais:

  • Estudantes de graduação: R$ 2.656,50 + vale transporte conforme Lei do Estágio
  • Estudantes de mestrado: R$ 4.972,20 + vale transporte conforme Lei do Estágio

Como se candidatar

Interessados/as devem enviar currículo e responder as perguntas a seguir até o dia 29 de março de 2026. Candidaturas serão avaliadas de modo contínuo por ordem de chegada.

O CPI é comprometido com os pilares de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão. Encorajamos fortemente a candidatura de pessoas pretas e pardas, mulheres, LGBTQIAPN+, pessoas com deficiência e indígenas e de povos e/ou comunidades tradicionais.

Esta vaga é exclusiva para alunos/as de graduação e mestrado da PUC‑Rio.

description:
REGULAMENTO DO PROCESSO SELETIVO

O CENTRO DE ESTUDOS E PESQUISAS CIÊNTIFICAS FRANCISCO ANTÔNIO DE SALLES – FAS, através do presente regulamento torna pública a abertura das inscrições e estabelece normas relativas à realização do Processo Seletivo para a vaga descrita abaixo, a ser contratada sob o Regime CLT por contrato de experiência. O presente processo seletivo não se trata de Concurso Público, não decorrendo, portanto, qualquer estabilidade diferente das que permitidas e exigidas pela CLT para contratos de experiência. Os dados pessoais que serão aqui coletados têm o intuito de cadastrar os interessados no Processo Seletivo para o cargo de Interesse. Ressaltamos que o acesso a essas informações e sua utilização é restrita aos responsáveis do Recursos Humanos.

DO PROCESSO SELETIVO

  • 1.1 O Processo Seletivo é regido pelas disposições contidas neste regulamento e seus anexos, possíveis adendos ou retificações e demais publicações pertinentes que serão disponibilizadas no site do FAS:
  • 1.2 O presente Processo Seletivo será realizado sob a responsabilidade do Recursos Humanos e Comissão de Processo Seletivo, designada pelo FAS, de acordo com as normas estabelecidas neste Edital.
  • 1.3 Não será permitida mais de uma inscrição por candidato, caso ocorram, a segunda inscrição será desconsiderada.
  • 1.4 É DE RESPONSABILIDADE EXCLUSIVA DO CANDIDATO, ACOMPANHAR todas as etapas do Cronograma e as publicações que poderão ser disponibilizadas NA PÁGINA DO PROCESSO SELETIVO no endereço eletrônico e ou através de contato telefônico / e-mail (não serão aceitos outlook, live, Hotmail). *O candidato que perder a data da próxima convocação não terá direito a pedido de recurso*.
  • 1.5 O Processo Seletivo terá validade de 3 meses a partir da data de contratação do candidato selecionado, podendo, mediante necessidade do FAS.
  • 1.6 O cargo, o número de vagas, a carga horária semanal, o vencimento mensal e os pré-requisitos exigidos para contratação serão informados na entrevista.
  • 1.7.6 o Processo Seletivo Será Composto De
    • 1ª ETAPA - Inscrição, de caráter eliminatório;
    • 2ª ETAPA - Análise dos documentos exigidos para cada cargo, de caráter eliminatório;
    • 3ª ETAPA - Avaliação de Competências e Habilidades Comportamentais, de caráter eliminatório e classificatório. Para esta etapa, serão convocados os candidatos classificados na Etapa de Análise documental considerando o mínimo de 03 (três) candidatos por vaga e/ou para formação de cadastro reserva;
    • 4ª ETAPA - Entrega de Documentos e Exame médico, de caráter eliminatório.

Somente possuirá direito a contratação o candidato que, após participar de todas as etapas previstas, for aprovado e classificado.

Descrição Do Cargo

  • Elaborar e organizar documentos comprobatórios de despesas e receitas para prestação de contas;
  • Conferir notas fiscais, garantindo sua conformidade com contratos e processos de compras;
  • Verificar guias de recolhimento de impostos, incluindo tributos sobre folha de pagamento e prestação de serviços;
  • Analisar e conferir folhas de pagamento;
  • Controlar e verificar a vigência de certidões fiscais;
  • Apoiar na consolidação de informações e relatórios utilizando Excel;
  • Manter a organização e atualização de arquivos físicos e digitais.

Requisitos

  • Ensino médio completo (desejável curso técnico ou superior em Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas);
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Excel;
  • Atenção aos detalhes e organização;

Diferenciais

About The Role

Uber for Family was made for family organizers who want to share their payment profile with their loved ones to pay, manage the spending limits and conveniently track their status and ETA when they invite them to join your Family Profile.

Uber for Teens is a customized experience inside Uber for Family exclusive for teenagers. Teen accounts give the teenager the freedom to request their own rides, all under supervision of their guardians. Plus, with live safety features and real-time updates, the guardian can follow along from pickup to drop off.

Joining the team, you will collaborate with the other team members to design, develop, and maintain user interfaces and features for mobile applications (Android).

As a Software Engineer at Uber, you will be a member of Uber's first Tech Center in Latin America! We are initially focused on sophisticated technologies to improve safety around the world, such as advanced telematics, machine learning, high scale distributed systems, real time data processing and mobile development, among others.

  • Partner with fellow engineers to build and maintain backend services and solutions to support user-facing products, downstream services, or infrastructure tools and platforms used across Uber, millions of Uber riders and drivers worldwide;
  • Work on Uber's most complex applications by designing, implementing, and unit testing the mobile application code;

  • Drive ongoing efficiency and reliability improvements through design and automation: availability, performance, scaling, monitoring and capacity;
  • Lead upstream and downstream dependencies, collaborate with other engineering teams, capture requirements, evolve solutions and enable successful adoption;

  • Go to person to get clarity of problem statements and also can break down into meaningful tasks;

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related field AND/ OR +4-year total technical software engineering experience;

  • Experience with Android SDK, strong knowledge of Android's core libraries, tools, and frameworks.
  • Knowledge of Android UI/UX Design Principles, experience designing responsive and intuitive user interfaces;
  • Advanced English language skills to work with other engineers and stakeholders from different regions around the world;

Preferred Qualifications

  • Understanding of Android Architecture Components and other architecture components for building scalable and maintainable apps;
  • Familiarity with Jetpack libraries to build modern Android apps;

  • Knowledge of performance tuning, usability and automation testing;

We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.

Objective

Provide strategic leadership and oversight of Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) performance across LATAM&C, ensuring full alignment with Worley’s global and regional HSE strategy. The role is responsible for driving a strong HSE culture, ensuring regulatory compliance, managing risk across EPC/EPCM projects and locations, and advising senior leadership on HSE matters. Decision Making

Supervision

Makes decisions related to the selection, training, discipline, and remuneration of staff. Establishes policy frameworks and long‑term mission and vision.

Communication

Effectively communicates and presents complex proposals and reports to senior management. Demonstrates the ability to persuade and influence others. Employs a participative management style with a collaborative, team‑oriented approach.

Systems, Processes & Tools

Demonstrates expert understanding of systems, processes, and tools related to the field. Able to coach and support others. May be involved in the development of new systems, processes, and tools.

Place of Work

Any LATAM&C location

Moving forward together

title: Senior Software Engineer - MAAS
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud‑ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get it there. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go, and we are looking for experienced software engineers who understand performance at scale, networking, storage and usability. Applicants should be passionate about the future of Ubuntu and be able to show technical leadership with a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion. This position requires international travel several times a year.

This role entails

  • Develop MAAS core components and features to make MAAS the #1 bare metal cloud system.
  • Shape the architecture of MAAS to make it simpler, faster and easier to use.
  • Collaborate with other teams to ensure MAAS works well with other tools and is released on time.
  • Contribute your improvements to our continuous integration environment, tests and practices, to maintain fast feedback and good test coverage.
  • Contribute to documentation of current and existing features, making it a world‑class resource for Data Centre operators and users.
  • Provide technical communication and collaboration with other teams where appropriate.
  • Take personal ownership of problems and drive them to solutions.
  • Travel internationally a few times a year to meet and collaborate with your and other teams.

What we are looking for in you

  • Passionate about open source software, Linux, and Data Centre automation.
  • Solid track record of professional software development experience in Python, Go for back‑end roles, or TypeScript, React for front‑end roles.
  • Capacity to learn quickly about new systems and techniques.
  • Excellent logic, problem‑solving, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Strong English language communication skills – both written and verbal.
  • Experience with Linux server technologies, including but not limited to Virtualization (KVM), Containers (LXC), etc.
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree.
  • Knowledge of network technologies, including PXE, DHCP, TFTP, DNS, NTP.
  • Some experience with Baseboard Management Controllers and Protocols (Redfish, IPMI, AMT and others).
  • Strong experience with networking, storage technologies and Cloud hosting and infrastructure.
  • Ideally, experience of large‑scale physical server provisioning and automation, including rapid deployment, configuration, management and service orchestration.
  • Familiarity with some of the open source development tools and methodologies used in creation of several Ubuntu projects (MAAS, Juju, Ubuntu Server, LXD, Ubuntu Core), such as Launchpad, Debian packaging tools (APT, dpkg) and snapcraft.
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university.
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events.

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 14 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.

description:
Estamos muito felizes por saber que você se interessou em embarcar em uma grande jornada aqui no Grupo EP, e para isso é muito importante que conheça um pouco mais sobre nós:

Temos quatro valores que regem nossos direcionamentos e atuação na EP, que são:

As operações terceirizadas tem como responsabilidade garantir o perfeito funcionamento das estações de tratamento do nosso cliente, a fim de não poluir o meio ambiente, atendendo as legislações ambientais e oferecendo água de qualidade para uso em processos internos, quando necessário.

title: Technical Team Lead – Windows Network Services
description:
Technical Team Lead – Windows Network Services

12month contract + Extensions

$37/hr - $46/hr

**Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

**Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

The Technical Team Lead – Windows Network Services is responsible for the day-to-day operation of Active Directory and related network identity services in their scope. This includes managing domain controllers, implementing Group Policy changes, ensuring DNS/DHCP are running smoothly, and responding to any incidents affecting authentication or network directory services. They implement the Architect’s designs and standards on the ground, making configuration changes and overseeing maintenance. Additionally, they support integrations (e.g., if a new application needs AD integration or certificates) and handle routine upgrades and patches for AD and its companion services.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate and Monitor AD Environments: Oversee the health of AD domains and domain controllers in the region. This includes monitoring replication, FSMO roles, AD logs, and ensuring backups and disaster recovery procedures for AD are in place.
  • Implement GPO Changes: Create or update Group Policy Objects as needed, following the architectural guidelines. Test GPO changes and roll them out, managing GPO conflicts or inheritance issues. Delegate GPO management appropriately.
  • Certificate and Naming Services: Manage the day-to-day of AD Certificate Services (issuing/revoking certificates, root CA maintenance) and core networking services like DNS, DHCP, and NTP servers. Ensure DNS zones are correct and replicated, DHCP scopes are managed, and time synchronization is consistent.
  • Security Control Implementation: Apply and uphold security controls as defined by the Architect. For example, enforce the use of privileged access workstations or other controls for AD admins, ensure service accounts are being used properly, and implement changes from any AD security assessments (such as patching LDAP signing issues, etc.)..
  • Incident Response: Act as the escalation point for any incidents involving AD or WNS services. Lead troubleshooting for outages or cyber incidents (like a suspected AD compromise). Coordinate with Security Operations if needed to contain and remediate issues.
  • Support Integrations: Work with other IT teams to integrate systems with AD (for authentication/SSO) or to set up new trust relationships. Assist in configuration of SSO, MFA, or PAM solutions as they interface with AD.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify areas to improve performance or stability of AD and WNS (e.g., decommissioning legacy domain controllers, fine-tuning DNS configurations, optimizing login scripts or group policy processing). Implement improvements and document changes.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or similar (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in Windows Server administration and Active Directory management. Familiarity with global AD deployments is a plus.
  • Strong experience with core network services on Windows (DNS, DHCP, DFS, Certificate Services). Able to configure and troubleshoot these services expertly.
  • Experience in an enterprise IT operations or infrastructure team, with responsibilities including change management and incident management for critical services.
  • Knowledge of identity integrations (how AD works with Azure AD/Azure AD Connect, SSO protocols like SAML/Kerberos, etc.), and experience implementing MFA or PAM in conjunction with AD is beneficial.

title: Gas Commercial Specialist - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.

Job Overview:

We are seeking a Gas Commercial Specialist to join our Innovation & Technology Management Group (ITMG) under Gas Operations Technical Support & Planning Department (GOTS&PD)

ITMG is responsible for the strategic growth and optimization of the gas business, integrating technical expertise, and digital and technologies innovation. ITMG also oversees the Master Gas Network planning, while optimizing the gas supply portfolio through advanced modeling and cost-benefit frameworks. It focuses on deploying cutting-edge technologies—such as AI, IoT, and digital twins to deliver high-impact solutions to shape the future of gas operations.

Your Primary role is to analyze and support strategic decision-making processes that optimize profitability, efficiency, and competitiveness in gas-related operations. You will also play a multidisciplinary in economic analysis, financial planning, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency to support Saudi Aramco’s gas business.

Key Responsibilities:

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Contribute to optimizing Gross Product Worth (GPW) and Earnings Before Interest and Taxes (EBIT).
  • Evaluate the Return on Average Capital Employed (ROACE), and ensure the economic life of assets (such as pipelines and processing facilities) is maximized. This involves assessing capital expenditures, operational costs, and revenue forecasts using methodologies like Net Present Value (NPV) and Internal Rate of Return (IRR).
  • Collaborate with energy and operation teams to implement energy efficiency initiatives, by analyzing data, modeling scenarios, and identifying energy-saving opportunities.
  • Reduce operational costs and enhance the overall efficiency of gas production and processing.
  • Analyze regional and global natural gas markets, including LNG, pipeline gas, NGLs, condensate, and associated products.
  • Develop gas demand–supply forecasts (short, medium, and long term).
  • Monitor macroeconomic indicators and assess their impact on gas business performance.
  • Evaluate price trends, energy competition (renewables, hydrogen), and policy changes.
  • Develop gas pricing models for various segments (power, industrial, petrochemicals).
  • Prepare economic justification for CAPEX and OPEX approvals.
  • Analyze gas supply contracts, demand profiles, and flexibility options to optimize the company’s gas portfolio.
  • Support balancing between long-term, mid-term, and spot gas strategies.
  • Recommend decisions on gas allocation, curtailment plans, and supply–demand balancing strategies.
  • Prepare comprehensive economic reports, dashboards, and presentations for senior leadership.
  • Deliver insights on risks, market dynamics, and strategic opportunities.
  • Support annual planning, corporate strategy development, and regulatory submissions.
  • Work closely with planning, operations, commercial, finance, and strategy teams.
  • Participate in investment review committees, commercial negotiations, and strategic projects.
  • Provide insights for policy development and regulatory frameworks.
  • As the successful candidate you hold a Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Industrial Engineering, Process Engineer, Mechanical, System Engineer). An advanced degree in Energy Economics, MBA, or Applied Economics is preferred.
  • You will have minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in Gas market analysis, Energy Economics, Commercial Planning, Oil & gas business planning, and Industrial commercial operations.
  • You will have Energy Risk Professional (ERP) certification.
  • Professional certifications such as CERA certificate or CFA Level ½ are preferred
  • You will have a strong background in Gas pricing mechanisms, Economic modeling (NPV, IRR, payback, sensitivity), Energy demand modeling, Scenario and risk analysis, Supply–demand balancing and optimization and understanding of gas processing and network.
  • You will be able to demonstrate Advanced economic modeling skills
  • You will have experience with energy economic tools (Palisade @Risk, PLEXOS, or similar).
  • You will have knowledge of global gas hubs (TTF, NBP, HH) and regional gas dynamics.
  • You will be able to simplify complex economic insights for executives.
  • You will have strategic thinking and commercial awareness and strong quantitative and analytical skills

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: Service Engineer, Offshore Cranes
description:
MacGregor is a global company that operates in 30 countries with 2000 employees. We provide sustainable cargo and load handling with a strong portfolio of products, services, and solutions to the maritime and offshore industries. Our solutions are found in over half of the world's merchant fleet.

We believe MacGregor is a great place to work and we are looking for innovators with an international mindset to join our team and help us create lifetime value for our customers.

MacGregor – Let's shape the future together

Are you driven by problem solving? Do you thrive working with complex and large equipment? Look no further, MacGregor is looking to hire a Service Engineer with strong Mechanical and Hydraulic competence. Knowledge of software and automation systems is a significant plus.

The purpose of this role is to execute service, repair and maintenance work, such as diagnostics, troubleshooting, repair of advanced hydraulic and mechanical equipment on the MacGregor product range, mostly cranes and winches.

We are looking for a candidate with previous experience within the offshore, ship, or rig equipment sector working with products such as winches, cranes and steering gears, but not limited to. Your main discipline is mechanical and hydraulic, in addition you have basic knowledge of electrical or/and automation components. As a person you are customer-oriented, cooperative, and have excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively share information within the team.

This is a position that requires that you travel to client sites, vessels or at shipyards worldwide. Our clients are primarily domestic but also spread across the globe, i.e. Europe, the US, China, Australia, Singapore, and beyond. Therefore, flexibility and a strong willingness to travel is essential. Our office and workshop is located in the Rio de Janeiro area where you might be assigned to local work if needed, therefore it is essential that you live within reach.

More Tasks And Responsibilities

  • Diagnostics and troubleshooting of mechanical and hydraulic systems
  • Advanced maintenance on hydraulic and mechanical, basic electrical and automation and maintenance of equipment
  • Supervise and perform service activities such as refurbishment, upgrades, inspections, preventative maintenance and corrective actions
  • Stay up to date with relevant developments, routines, processes and news
  • Provide information and write reports as required
  • Support sales activities such as follow-up on leads and quotes while at site, as agreed with sales responsible
  • Follow all site safety rules, agreed working practices and environmental requirements
  • Comply with all relevant safety and quality requirements according to MacGregor

Reporting directly to the Operations Superintendent. The position will be based in MacGregor’s office in Rio de Janeiro, (Niterói / São Gonçalo).

What You’ll Need To Succeed

  • Technical education at Bachelors or Technical College level within Mechanical or Hydraulic. Relevant experience may compensate for lack of education
  • Minimum 7 years of experience from similar position
  • Experience with hydraulic and mechanical drawings
  • Previous experience with winches, cranes, steering gear is a must
  • Basic knowledge in both automation and/or electrical fields is a valuable asset
  • Proven experience working with computer systems professionally
  • Good English language - both verbal and written

Why MacGregor?

Our people are behind every success. People create the technology and product lifecycle solutions that make us great, our people are the ones who innovate, and people drive our business forward. With us you will be part of an international collaborative working culture with challenges and opportunities to further develop yourself professionally. We enable sustainable global maritime operations by maximizing efficiency in cargo and load handling.

Values guide our work

  • Integrity steers all our thinking, behaviour and the relationships with our customers and other stakeholders
  • Quality is valued in our processes, products and services and helps to improve our customers’ performance and our own competences
  • Safety is essential in everything we do

MacGregor is an equal opportunity employer. We recognise that diversity is key to our continued success, and strive to maintain a fair and equitable recruitment process for all applicants.

title: Associate, Program Management
description:
Associate, Program Management, Higher Education

Posting Date: 03/20/2026. Deadline: 04/05/2026

Role Details

Contract Type: Regular

Reporting To: Director, Higher Education

Program/Department/Unit Name: Ideas Workshop

Location: Bogota, Mexico City, Rio de Janeiro or Nairobi (This is a hybrid position with the successful candidate expected to spend 50% of their time in the office)

Team Name: Higher Education

The higher education team works to fund universities and attendant programs that address open society challenges through research and teaching; to promote and defend academic freedom and reasoned debate; and to advance the inclusion of displaced and threatened students and scholars.

Role Purpose

This Associate, Program Management, role contributes to and supports higher education related grants and projects in the Ideas Workshop. The Higher Education team supports OSF’s core higher education partners through grantmaking and expertise, fosters and sustains collaboration, and contributes to strengthening the quality and effectiveness of the institutions supported by OSF. The Associate, Program Management, will primarily be responsible for managing the grant making process, communicating with grantees on proposal development and submission, manage payments, reporting and other related processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Effectively manage the grant making processes related to the higher education team’s objectives. This responsibility includes day‑to‑day liaison with grantees about proposal development and submission, providing feedback and reviewing budgets, overseeing grant record preparation, ensuring timely processing of grants, payments and reports, and undertaking periodic reviews of progress with grantees, including site visits and attendance of program meetings.
  • Build a strong understanding of the organizational grant making rules and policies. Help design grant selection processes and projects.
  • Work collaboratively with other members within the team and with colleagues across OSF to ensure the team is effectively leveraging OSF’s capabilities to reach the agreed outcome.
  • Communicate with and build collaborative relationships with grantees and partners. Provide guidance on OSF processes and procedures. Provide expertise, both internally and externally, to support the development of grantee organizations and projects.
  • Assist in the construction, maintenance, and assessment of grant making, sharing responsibility for design with manager.
  • Provide support for internal and external initiatives and events with the Administration Officer, including support in conceptualizing events, identifying speakers, developing event agenda, and working with operations colleagues to manage event logistics.
  • Manage and oversee consultant contracts, as needed.
  • Contribute to planning and development of annual goals and budgets.
  • Perform other tasks and take on other responsibilities, as required by the Director, Higher Education.

Key Internal Relationships

Program Managers, Grant Management, Operations.

Key External Relationships

Higher education partners, CEU and other grantees

The Ideal Candidate

  • Educated to a degree-level (or equivalent).
  • Substantial relevant experience in non‑governmental organizations, universities, think tanks, arts and culture organizations, philanthropy, development, consulting, and/or the public sector.
  • Understanding of the field of higher education and key trends and developments. Experience working at or with higher education institutions.
  • Excellent strategic and analytical skills. Complex project management experience.
  • The candidate must be willing to be flexible as their areas of work may expand/change in the future depending on the skills and experience of the successful candidate, as well as the needs of the program.
  • Grant making experience will be an advantage.
  • Experience in more than one geographic region will be a strong asset.
  • Ability to think broadly and design project management systems and approaches.
  • Advanced analytical and problem‑solving abilities to identify, assess, and mitigate risks effectively.
  • Proficiency in using data‑driven approaches to make informed decisions and recommendations.
  • High emotional intelligence, humility and empathy; the ability to relate to people across cultures; and excellent inter‑personal skills, with the diplomatic demeanor and political astuteness necessary to represent a global organization.
  • Demonstrates commitment to OSF’s core values of humility, commitment, collaboration, respect, inclusivity and integrity.
  • Commitment to open society values of human rights, transparency and accountability, and democratic governance.
  • Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion by recognizing and responding positively to individual and group differences in the workplace and beyond. Building an inclusive workplace by respecting and seeking out diverse viewpoints and perspectives.
  • An excellent knowledge of English
  • Knowledge of other languages would be an asset
  • Travel (25%)

What We Offer

  • Exceptional opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact; from a generous annual professional development allowance for every employee to onsite training and learning conversations with visiting experts.
  • Excellent benefits and perks to promote well‑being and a healthy work‑life balance, including:
  • Generous time off and flexible work arrangements.
  • Employer‑paid health insurance and dental plans for individuals and families (no employee contribution required).
  • Exceptional retirement savings plan (non‑contributory for employees) and life insurance.
  • Progressive paid parental leave, reproductive and family planning support, and much more.
  • A commitment to nurturing a diverse and inclusive workplace, so you can bring your whole self to work and make a positive impact.

Who We Are

Open Society Foundations aim to establish vibrant and inclusive democracies where governments are accountable to their citizens. Our operating model organizes grantmaking around specific, time‑limited projects, developed alongside support for established partners, enabling us to respond swiftly to emerging needs. We are committed to promoting human dignity, equality, and rights; reimagining democratic ideals and practice; and advancing equity in governance systems.

Guided by our founder’s values and the belief in the art of the possible, we engage directly with global entities, individuals, and policymakers through grants, advocacy, impact investing, and strategic human rights litigation to drive positive change. At the heart of our mission is a deep commitment to rights, equity, and justice, inspiring every action we take.

Additional Information

Open Society Foundations is committed to building an inclusive workforce that reflects the communities we serve. We actively seek applications from talented individuals across all backgrounds, identities, and life experiences. Each candidate is evaluated solely on their unique qualifications without regard to race, age, sex, religion, ethnic origin, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, or any other legally protected characteristics.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities.

Competitive rates of pay apply.

Open Society Foundations is committed to advancing diversity, equity and inclusion, and to building a diverse staff that reflects the movements, issues and communities that our mission serves. Candidates from all underrepresented backgrounds, identities and communities are encouraged to apply.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants and colleagues with disabilities.

description:
Descrição Sumária

Responsável por apoiar os processos de planejamento de recursos organizacionais (headcount), assegurando a atualização, integridade e alinhamento das informações de força de trabalho entre RH, Finanças e áreas funcionais. Atua na consolidação de dados, acompanhamento das necessidades de pessoal e suporte às análises que orientam decisões de alocação de recursos, estrutura e orçamento de headcount.

What will you be doing?

Responsável por apoiar os processos de planejamento de recursos organizacionais (headcount), assegurando a atualização, integridade e alinhamento das informações de força de trabalho entre RH, Finanças e áreas funcionais. Atua na consolidação de dados, acompanhamento das necessidades de pessoal e suporte às análises que orientam decisões de alocação de recursos, estrutura e orçamento de headcount.

Responsabilidades e Desafios Principais

  • Conduzir processo mensal de planejamento de headcount, garantindo que as informações estejam atualizadas, consistentes e alinhadas com a demanda das áreas.
  • Acompanhar e controlar solicitações de abertura, movimentação e reposição de posições, contribuindo para o controle da estrutura organizacional.
  • Analisar previsões de headcount (curto, médio e longo prazo) fornecidas pelas áreas funcionais e antecipar tendências para a gerência e diretoria.
  • Colaborar com os membros dos departamentos de RH e Finanças na reconciliação dos dados de headcount, custo de pessoal e orçamento.
  • Auxiliar na identificação de riscos e desvios relacionados ao planejamento de recursos, propondo ações corretivas.
  • Contribuir para análises de Workforce Planning Estratégico, apoiando estudos de tendências futuras de capacidade organizacional.
  • Manter registros e bases de dados relacionados a headcount organizados, atualizados e dentro das regras de governança.
  • Agendar e realizar de reuniões com stakeholders para coleta de informações, alinhamento e apresentação de análises de headcount.
  • Apoiar a melhoria contínua dos processos de planejamento de recursos, contribuindo para maior padronização e eficiência.
  • Elaborar relatórios e visões consolidadas para apoio à tomada de decisão, utilizando Excel e Power BI como ferramentas de suporte às análises.
  • Atualizar dashboards padronizados de headcount, garantindo coerência com as bases oficiais.
  • Apoiar iniciativas simples de automatização e integração entre bases de dados de RH, sem foco técnico aprofundado.
  • Utiliza ferramentas como Excel e Power BI como suporte analítico, mas com foco central em processos de RH, governança e planejamento.

What experience would we like you to have?

Conhecimentos Necessários

  • Inglês Fluente ;
  • Conhecimento funcional em Power BI (visualização e tratamento básico de dados);
  • Experiência com Workforce Planning

Quais os cursos e conhecimentos que o ocupante da posição deve ter?

  • Graduação superior em Análise de Dados, Ciência de Dados ou áreas afins.
  • Microsoft Excel
  • Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Automate e Power Apps)
  • Desejável conhecimentos em Big Data e IA

Valorizamos a diversidade e vemos as diferenças como oportunidades ao invés de barreiras, assegurando condições de pleno desenvolvimento dos nossos profissionais e, também, para a sociedade. Todas as nossas vagas são elegíveis para pessoas com deficiência e/ou reabilitadas.

  • Parceria pioneira com o SESC com o espaço SESC + SAÚDE, oferecendo serviços gratuitos de odontologia e saúde da mulher (preventivo e mamografia) aos nossos funcionários.

SOBRE NÓS!

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome “Casas Guanabara”, o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.

Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.

E não para por aí!

A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.

Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.

O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara!

A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como A marca mais amada do Rio e por 15 anos pela pesquisa “Marcas dos Cariocas”, em parceria com O Globo, a Marca preferida dos Cariocas .

E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 14 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.

Já imaginou fazer parte de uma empresa inovadora, que segue tendência mundial no setor de supermercados e conta com muitos talentos?

Se a sua resposta for sim, aqui é o seu lugar!

title: Digital Project Manager
description:
The QIMA story
At Qima, we are on a mission to offer our clients smart solutions to make products you can trust. Operating in over 100 countries, we serve the consumer products, food, and life sciences industries and help more than 30,000 brands, retailers, manufacturers, and growers achieve quality excellence. We combine on-the- ground expertise with digital solutions that bring accuracy, transparency and intelligence for quality and compliance data. We are a leading provider of supply chain compliance solutions, partnering with brands, retailers, and importers to secure, manage, and optimize their global supply network.

Company Description
The QIMA story
At Qima, we are on a mission to offer our clients smart solutions to make products you can trust. Operating in over 100 countries, we serve the consumer products, food, and life sciences industries and help more than 30,000 brands, retailers, manufacturers, and growers achieve quality excellence. We combine on-the- ground expertise with digital solutions that bring accuracy, transparency and intelligence for quality and compliance data. We are a leading provider of supply chain compliance solutions, partnering with brands, retailers, and importers to secure, manage, and optimize their global supply network.
Qima’s industry-leading experts for onsite inspections, supplier audits, and lab testing are supported by a digital platform that provides accuracy, transparency, and intelligence for quality and compliance data. Our culture is unique, with our 5,000 Qimates making decisions every day based on our Qima Values.
Job Description
Help us drive the adoption and delivery of innovative digital solutions that improve efficiency, client experience, and compliance across the global food TIC (Testing, Inspection & Certification) industry. We are looking for a Digital Project Manager who can coordinate cross-regional initiatives, support client onboarding, and ensure successful implementation of digital tools across operations.
This role sits at the intersection of product, operations, and client engagement, helping translate business needs into effective digital solutions while ensuring strong adoption across regions.
Key Missions
Digital Project Delivery : Lead the execution of digital initiatives from planning to rollout. Coordinate with product, engineering, QA, and business teams to ensure projects are delivered on time and aligned with operational needs.
Client Onboarding & Adoption: Support the onboarding of internal teams and external clients to new digital tools and platforms. Monitor adoption, identify barriers to usage, and work with stakeholders to improve engagement and value realization.
Cross-Regional Coordination : Act as the key point of coordination between regional teams in Latin America and global teams in Asia and Europe. Ensure alignment on priorities, timelines, and implementation strategies.
Business Analysis & Solution Design : Work with stakeholders to understand operational needs and document requirements, workflows, and user stories. Contribute to designing practical digital solutions that improve efficiency and data quality.
Data & Adoption Insights : Track product usage and operational data to assess adoption and identify improvement opportunities. Use insights from client interactions and operational teams to inform future enhancements.
Testing & Implementation : Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and support smooth rollouts of new features and tools. Ensure issues are addressed quickly and users are supported during implementation.
Field Engagement : Engage directly with operational teams and auditors to observe workflows, gather feedback, and ensure digital tools effectively support real-world inspection and audit processes.
Qualifications
We are looking for someone who:

  • Has experience managing digital or technology projects in complex operational environments
  • Is comfortable working across regions and time zones
  • Can engage with clients and operational teams to drive adoption
  • Has strong organizational and communication skills
  • Is able to work independently while coordinating multiple stakeholders
  • Has experience with Agile or digital product delivery environments
Experience in Food, Quality, Compliance, or TIC industries is a plus.

  • Graduação completa, preferencialmente em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Psicologia, Engenharia de Produção, Gestão de Pessoas, Processos ou áreas correlatas.

  • Atuação relevante em remuneração, cargos e salários e programas de incentivos;
  • Experiência na revisão e/ou estruturação de modelos de remuneração variável (curto e longo prazo), considerando diferentes níveis organizacionais;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de avaliação de desempenho, gestão de metas e competências;
  • Atuação com indicadores de RH, KPIs e análises para suporte à tomada de decisão;
  • Experiência em desenho, revisão e implementação de projetos de RH com visão end-to-end;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office, com ênfase em Excel e PowerPoint;
  • Conhecimento em Power BI e construção de dashboards (diferencial);
  • Vivência com People Analytics e análises quantitativas aplicadas à gestão de pessoas;
  • Experiência com descrição, avaliação e arquitetura de cargos.

Conhecimento Técnico:

  • Domínio de metodologias de avaliação de cargos (ex.: Mercer, Hay ou similares);
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de pesquisas salariais e estudos de mercado;
  • Conhecimento de práticas e tendências de remuneração e gestão de desempenho.

Descrição Sumária

INSCRIÇÕES ABERTAS – até 30/03/2026. O prazo poderá ser alterado sem aviso prévio.

  • O profissional atuará na área operacional de um projeto ou de uma proposta, incorporado no PMT, e será responsável por coordenar as atividades de planejamento de projetos de alta complexidade, estabelecendo interfaces estratégicas com o cliente, fornecedores e demais membros do time de projeto.

  • Dentro do projeto se reportará ao “Gerente de Controle de Projeto”, dependendo do tipo de projeto; e funcionalmente ao “Gerente de Planejamento” e ficará locado no Escritório do Rio de Janeiro.

Responsabilidades e Desafios Principais

Desenvolver e conduzir, desde o estágio inicial, o cronograma de projetos EPCI complexos na fase de BID, estruturando WBS, considerando restrições contratuais, folgas estratégicas, simulações e cenários alternativos, com autonomia, confidencialidade e alinhamento às regras corporativas. Implementar a WBS do projeto e analisar documentação de propostas e contratos, emitindo os documentos de planejamento conforme requisitos.

Realizar análise crítica aplicando a metodologia CPM, propondo soluções quando necessário. Garantir que mudanças do BID ou do contrato sejam refletidas e avaliadas no cronograma, permitindo identificar possíveis Variation Orders do cliente. Desenvolver análises de cenário considerando diferentes layouts submarinos e sequenciamentos operacionais, apoiando a liderança na tomada de decisão.

Gerenciar no cronograma o planejamento de fornecedores e subcontratados, definindo metodologia de medição de progresso de acordo com exigências contratuais. Manter comunicação eficaz com fornecedores, subcontratados e equipes internas, consolidando o cronograma do BID ou do projeto. Acompanhar pacotes de fabricação dos equipamentos para garantir consistência entre os cronogramas.

Construir, junto ao cliente, o cronograma Baseline do projeto e realizar eventuais re-baselines ao longo do avanço. Garantir integração entre Project Controllers, Package Managers e Contract Managers, assegurando qualidade das entregas. Identificar riscos e oportunidades relacionadas ao planejamento.

Coletar e inserir dados de progresso no cronograma, avaliando impactos conforme métodos definidos em contrato. Gerenciar mudanças de escopo, correções e impactos no planejamento, em colaboração com o Project Controls Manager. Orientar e apoiar Analistas de Planejamento em diferentes níveis, atuando como referência técnica. Assegurar a aplicação dos padrões de planejamento da Subsea 7 e disseminar conhecimento da disciplina na organização.

  • Domínio de Primavera P6 e MS Project.
  • Power BI avançado.
  • Noções sólidas de gestão e planejamento de projetos.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Conhecimento em Primavera Risk Analysis e Crystal Ball.
  • Noções do módulo de planejamento do ProArc.

Formação

Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Administração ou Economia (ciências exatas). Desejável.

Experiência

Desejável experiência mínima de 8 anos em Planejamento de Projetos. Capacidade de elaborar planos de ação sempre que necessário.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!
 are seeking a key role for the School of Social Work. Reporting to the Associate Dean and operating under the Office of Academic and Student Advancement, the Clinical Education Director provides executive leadership, strategic direction, and operational oversight for all supervised field education and practicum experiences within the MSW program, serving both on-campus and online students. This role is responsible for ensuring the quality, accessibility, compliance, and continuous improvement of agency-based education in alignment with the Council on Social Work Education (CSWE) Educational Policy and Accreditation Standards (EPAS).
This role serves as a strategic leader responsible for guiding the continued evolution, growth, and innovation of the Agency-Based Education enterprise. The Director leads efforts to enhance systems, workflows, staffing models, agency partnerships, and student support structures in alignment with best practices, emerging trends, and technologies in social work field education, and the School’s commitment to equitable access, accreditation integrity, operational excellence, and student success across residential and online learning environments.
The position requires the implementation of structured accessibility and communication systems to support students enrolled across multiple U.S. time zones and evening instructional schedules, reflecting the school’s commitment to inclusion, equity, and student success.
Supervisory Authority
This position provides direct or indirect supervision of faculty consultants/liaisons, administrative staff, and assigned graduate or undergraduate student workers
Nature and Scope
Internal contacts include the Dean’s Office, senior administrators, program directors, faculty, students, and staff; HUSSW committees; and university-wide units such as the Office of Student Accessibility, University Counseling Services, and the Office of General Counsel.
External contacts include agency supervisors and administrators, third-party online program partners, community organizations, CSWE and other accreditation entities, licensure bodies, and vendors.
This is an onsite position. Operational availability is required to support students and faculty across PST, MST, CST, and EST time zones, as well as evening academic schedules during peak periods such as orientation, registration, and graduation.
Principal Accountabilities
I. Strategic Leadership & Program Governance
  • Provide vision, leadership, and strategic direction for Agency-Based Education across all MSW modalities
  • Serve as the institutional expert for agency-based education governance, policy development, and operational decision-making
  • Represent Agency-Based Education on School and University committees to ensure alignment with academic and student success priorities
II. Systems Design & Modernization
  • Lead the continued evolution and modernization of the Agency-Based Education function by enhancing systems, workflows, and operational models to build capacity for current and future program needs
  • Implement scalable, technology-enabled systems for student intake, placement tracking, agency management, and compliance monitoring
  • Advance and formalize standardize processes that support scalability, equity, transparency, and a consistent student experience across modalities as agency-based education continues to grow
  • Lead change management initiatives to support faculty, staff, students, and agency partners through operational transitions
III. Student Accessibility & Learner Support
  • Design and manage a student-centered accessibility framework enabling students to proactively communicate availability, work schedules, learning needs, and accommodation considerations
  • Establish service standards and response expectations to ensure equitable access for all MSW students
  • Oversee student placement support, remediation strategies, and escalation processes when placement challenges arise
IV. Agency Partnership Development & Oversight
  • Recruit, evaluate, approve, and maintain agency partnerships
  • Establish agency quality standards and site evaluation protocols
  • Serve as final authority for agency continuation or termination
V. Accreditation, Assessment & Compliance

Opportunity Description
This work will focus on promoting and safeguarding inclusive democratic governance in Latin America and the Caribbean. The effort will identify, develop, and support regional and national efforts to advance democracy.
Role Purpose
Directors are highly accomplished, well-networked in their field, and bring deep experience in their geographic and/or thematic area of specialty. Director of Programs oversee individual Opportunities, these are timebound programs designed to solve complex problems central to our strategic direction, for their duration and are accountable for delivering on its outcomes as well as for the management of their teams at the highest level of professionalism.
Key Responsibilities
As Director of Programs, you will:

  • Accountable for articulating a creative and exciting opening to make impact in the world into a workable project plan for implementation according to established criteria
  • Evaluate an Opportunity based on established metrics for MEL and ability to pivot to ensure the required outcomes are being achieved
  • Ensure appropriate financial, risk, and legal management and control are articulated during the planning and implementation phase, and work with all relevant stakeholders to develop mitigation plans
  • Oversee and manage the Opportunity team, including external partners
  • Engage with embedded staff from other OSF teams in close cooperation with senior leaders
  • Articulate budgetary and workforce needs for an Opportunity leveraging internal and external resources, as required
  • Monitor and regularly report on the progress of an Opportunity to the Managing Director of Programs and other senior OSF leaders
  • Leverage OSF’s work globally and employing the strategic capabilities of impact investment, strategic litigation, and advocacy to the Opportunity
  • Represent the given Opportunity and organization externally at all levels, and grow a network accordingly that includes actors beyond the social sector into national and local governments, multilateral organizations, faith-based groups, grass-roots organizations, philanthropy, local experts, academia and think tanks, etc. to advance the Opportunity. Depending on the Opportunity this might include developing strong relationships with other funders and bringing them as partners into the Opportunity
  • Travel is required. Travel frequency depends on the role requirements.
People Responsibilities (Total Team/DRs
Yes
Key internal relationships
Program Teams; Managing Director Programs; Managing Director Core Partner (+ teams); Grants Management; Advocacy; SEDF; Comms; Strategic Litigation; Operations; OGC & Risk
Key external relationships
External partners, public and private sector leaders
The ideal candidate
  • Prior experience in leading social change and system- change work in civil society, government, multilateral institutions, and/or the private sector that has resulted in positive societal impact
  • Extensive expertise in the specific topic area as set out in the “Opportunity Description” above
  • Prior financial ($20m+), legal and risk accountability at large-scale programmatic level
  • Network across the social sector in national and local governments, multilateral organizations, faith-based groups, grass-roots organizations, philanthropy, local experts, academia, and think tanks
  • Proven people management experience (of individual contributors and external partners)
  • Prior experience leading programmatic or organizational level change within organizations and/or systems that have gone through significant transformation
  • Experience in multiple sectors and knowledge of philanthropic tools such as advocacy and communication, strategic litigation, and social impact approaches
  • Ability to design and plan complex programs/opportunities involving cross collaboration and articulating the time, budget, stakeholder and success measures
  • Skilled in building strategic external partnerships that promote OSF’s interests and align to its strategic objectives
  • Able to nurture relationships with external partners whilst exercising considerable discretion
  • Skilled in drafting and managing a proposal development process
  • Knowledge of grant making best practices and the field of philanthropy

  • Employer-paid health insurance and dental plans for individuals and families (no employee contribution required).
  • Exceptional retirement savings plan (non-contributory for employees) and life insurance.
  • Progressive paid parental leave, reproductive and family planning support, and much more.
  • A commitment to nurturing a diverse and inclusive workplace, so you can bring your whole self to work and make a positive impact.
Who We Are
Open Society Foundations aim to establish vibrant and inclusive democracies where governments are accountable to their citizens. Our operating model organizes grantmaking around specific, time-limited projects, developed alongside support for established partners, enabling us to respond swiftly to emerging needs. We are committed to promoting human dignity, equality, and rights; reimagining democratic ideals and practice; and advancing equity in governance systems.
Guided by our founder’s values and the belief in the art of the possible, we engage directly with global entities, individuals, and policymakers through grants, advocacy, impact investing, and strategic human rights litigation to drive positive change. At the heart of our mission is a deep commitment to rights, equity, and justice, inspiring every action we take.
Additional Information
Open Society Foundations is committed to building an inclusive workforce that reflects the communities we serve. We actively seek applications from talented individuals across all backgrounds, identities, and life experiences. Each candidate is evaluated solely on their unique qualifications without regard to race, age, sex, religion, ethnic origin, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: TECNICO DE ENFERMAGEM DO TRABALHO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Desempenhar atividades de enfermagem, sob a supervisão do enfermeiro, realizar coleta de material biológico e outras atividades administrativas garantindo o fluxo adequado dos exames ocupacionais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ter idade minima de 18 anos completos.
  • Ensino Médio Completo.

  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
  • Experiência de 06 meses comprovada na função de Técnico de Enfermagem do Trabalho.

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.Com The Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group. In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations. As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini’s deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization. Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time. Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency. Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required. Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Técnico(A) De Serviços - Rj
description:
Resumo do cargo: O Técnico de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido. Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão: 1) Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sitemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);
2) Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas, diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;
3) Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;
4) Análise de projetose estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;
5) Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.E. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
6) Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
7) Elaboração,desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
8) Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
9) Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial. Quem você é: Você distingue prontamente entre o que é relevante e o que é irrelevante para compreender situações complexas. Você encontra pontos em comum e conduz as coisas para o consenso, garantindo que todos se sintam ouvidos. Você utiliza insights dos clientes para impulsionar e orientar o desenvolvimento de novas ofertas. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam constantemente. Para este cargo, você precisará: Formação Técnica em Automação;
Ter experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
Conhecimento avançadono pacote MS Office;
Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition etc;
Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado. Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você: Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

description:

Acompanhar e apoiar as atividades de soldagem realizadas pela equipe, auxiliando também o
mecânico em reparos e manutenções. Executar serviços de soldagem e corte em peças metálicas
utilizando diversos processos (eletrodo revestido, TIG, MIG, MAG, oxigás, arco submerso,
brasagem, plasma), preparando os equipamentos, acessórios e materiais necessários. Garantir
a qualidade dos serviços, seguindo rigorosamente as normas de segurança, organização do
local de trabalho e preservação do meio ambiente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Tarefas incluem, mas não se limitam a:
Realizar desmontagem e montagem de equipamentos, utilizando ferramentas específicas para
reparo e substituição de peças, com o objetivo de melhorar o desempenho e prolongar a vida
útil dos mesmos;

Auxiliar diariamente nas atividades de soldagem, distribuindo as tarefas entre os
colaboradores, definindo prioridades e oferecendo suporte técnico, garantindo a correta
execução dos serviços;
Executar mensalmente reparos em equipamentos e máquinas nos portos de Itaguaí e Rio de
Janeiro, incluindo solicitação de materiais e pintura de lataria, além de modificações
internas para melhoria de desempenho;
Efetuar, eventualmente, lavagem de máquinas com desmontagem parcial, aplicação de
desoxidantes e primer à base de zinco nas peças, prevenindo ferrugem e aumentando a
durabilidade dos componentes.
;
Realizar, quando necessário, a fabricação de novas caçambas, incluindo desenho técnico,
medição, corte de chapas com maçarico e acabamento com esmerilhadora, garantindo a
adequação às máquinas específicas.
Corrigir avarias em escadas metálicas, removendo chapas amassadas e executando solda
(processo MIG), sempre utilizando os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) adequados
para garantir segurança e qualidade.
Modificar, quando necessário, estruturas de máquinas, como bases de vidro, portas, arcondicionado
e teto solar, com foco em aumentar o conforto dos operadores e reduzir o
desgaste dos equipamentos;
Executar serviços de soldagem em estruturas metálicas como portas, escadas, telhados de
